chat.title: Design assistant
chat.intro: Describe a glass bead or a charm. The assistant proposes parameters and cites the manual; the rules are checked by code, and nothing is reserved or generated until you confirm.
chat.example1: A 10 mm faceted amber bead for the Amber Hollow collection
chat.example2: A gold-plated crescent moon charm with a star, 16 mm tall
chat.example3: Una cuenta redonda de 8 mm en cobalto con agujero de 1,5 mm
chat.question1: What's the smallest hole I can put in a glass bead?
chat.question2: Which fonts can I use for an initial charm?
chat.newDesignConfirm: Start over? The chat and the panel are cleared; reserved SKUs, design files and renders stay saved.

demo.tooltip: No language model is connected. The assistant answers from a curated list of questions about the manual, through the real tools; the panel, the checks and the cards work as usual.

panel.title: Parameters
panel.empty: Choose a family, or describe the product in the chat and the assistant fills these in.
panel.material: Material: {{material}} ({{density}} g/cm³). All lengths in mm.
panel.checkFailed: The check could not run; is the backend up?

actions.title: Workflow
actions.hint: Each button opens a short form; Review & confirm then opens a confirmation card in the chat, with the same checks the assistant uses. Nothing happens until you click Confirm.
actions.reserveDesc: Reserve a SKU and product name in SAP for this family.
actions.generateDesc: Write STEP, STL, GLB and the PDF drawing for a SKU and revision.
actions.renderDesc: Queue a catalog render of the generated revision in Blender.
actions.name: Product name
actions.nameHint: Two or three English words in Title Case; “{{suffix}}” is added at the end for you.
actions.nameFree: Free in the catalog and follows GEN-03.
actions.nameNoSap: SAP is not reachable: only the pattern was checked, not the catalog.
actions.needSku: Reserve a SKU first, or type an existing one.
actions.doneGenerate: Rev {{rev}} files written (STEP, STL, GLB, PDF)
actions.rendersSaved: Renders the saved Rev {{rev}}, not your current edits.
actions.lastRender: Last render: Rev {{rev}} (job #{{id}}). Render Rev {{current}} for the catalog.
actions.cardOpened: Card opened in the chat. Confirm it there.

panel.seeFields: Fix the fields marked in red ({{fields}}):

viewer.title: 3D model
viewer.label: 3D model of the {{family}}
viewer.empty: The model appears here when the parameters are valid.
viewer.invalid: Fix the rule violations to see the model.
viewer.overallHeight: Overall height with the loop: {{height}} mm.

outputs.noDesign: No files yet. Reserve a SKU first, then generate the files (Generate files… in the panel, or ask the assistant); the drawing appears here after you confirm the card.
outputs.noRender: No render queued in this session. Renders run locally with Blender; below is the pre-generated gallery.
outputs.galleryNote: Rendered locally with Blender (Cycles) and committed for the online demo.

stale.title: Parameters changed since Rev {{rev}}
stale.body: The drawing and files are out of date.

outputs.renderUsually: A render usually takes 1 to 2 minutes.
outputs.noDesignReserved: {{sku}} is reserved. Generate its files (Generate files… in the panel, or ask the assistant); the drawing appears here after you confirm the card.

explain.reserve_sku: Confirm reserves the next free SKU and SAP material number. Numbers are never reused.
explain.generate_design: Confirm checks the rules again and writes STEP, STL, GLB and the drawing PDF. Existing revisions are never overwritten.
explain.render: Confirm queues a Blender render of this revision.

card.name: Name
card.expiredHelp: Cards expire after 30 minutes; ask the assistant again.
card.brokenRules: The panel's design breaks {{rules}} right now. The SKU is reserved anyway (it names the product); the files can only be generated once the design passes.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.note: Materials from the (mock) SAP: the existing products and the SKUs reserved in Bead Studio, with the revisions that have files.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.sapDown: SAP is not available right now; try again later.
catalog.sizeFromDesign: From the generated files: SAP has no size for a new reservation yet
